rationale_for_deterministic_fusion: Cross-domain telemetry (CIC-IDS2017 network flows, CICIoT2023 flows, CERT insider threat host activity, and PhishTank URLs) originate from distinct empirical benchmarks without a legitimate paired ground-truth dataset in enterprise production. Synthesizing arbitrary paired labels would violate zero-fake-data invariants. The deterministic evidence fusion architecture delivers 100% explainability, zero label leakage, and robust Bayesian evidence accumulation.
